chartIdMeans: charts/<id>.json inside website_loader/ (the published chart file; identical to the .soda stem in analysis/chart-inventory.json)
pathBase: workspace root (the parent of website_loader/); server.mjs resolves entries with path.resolve(root, mapped). Mapped files are never published with the viewer, so a standalone clone simply has no audio.

valueForms.object: { path, duration, source, format, audioFilename, offset, match, fileLength, chartFirstNote, chartLastNote, chartDuration, verification, notes }

offsetConvention: chartTime = audioPosition - outputLatency - offset, and mediaPosition = max(0, chartTime + offset + outputLatency); offset is the chart's serialized audio offset (same value server.mjs publishes as charts[].offset). The max() clamp at the file start is the only non-invertible part: with offset > 0 chart second 0 starts at file position offset (the file's beginning is skipped), and with offset < 0 requested media positions are clamped to 0 until chartTime reaches -offset (approximate pre-roll; sample-exact delayed start is not implemented). Chart times in this file come from the parent's compiled engine.js, not from an independent re-derivation.

reliability.whatThisMapIs: candidate pairings of local audio files that match a chart by file name, base name or title (the game's AudioLocator order)
reliability.whatThisMapIsNot: NOT proof that the file is the same master/version/edit/encode the chart was authored against, and NOT verified sample-exact synchronisation. A name match cannot distinguish two edits of the same song.
reliability.uiRecommendation: label mapped audio as 'local audio found (unverified match)' rather than 'audio ready/synced', and show the per-entry verification/notes text
reliability.noAudioBehaviour: an id absent from this map is a silent preview: server sends audioUrl null and PlaybackClock.load(null) runs the monotonic fallback
